d:
Sonia Gandhi ne lonch ki naee Book, Akhilesh Yadav, Hemant Soren samet jute INDIA Bloc ke diggaj neta
Kangres sansdiy dal ki adhyaksh soniya gandhi (Sonia Gandhi) ki naee kitab 'bilonging: e jarni oph lav' (Belonging: A Journey of Love) ki dilli ke hotal aaeetisi maury men aupcharik lonching huee. is dauran soniya gandhi ne kaha ki unke bachchon rahul aur priyanka gandhi ne unhen kitab likhne ke lie prerit kiya. unhonne spasht kiya ki unke parivar ke bare men kaee aisi baten phailaee gaeen jo sach nahin thin, islie logon ke samne sahi sachchaee rakhne ke lie unhonne yah kitab likhi.
